Skylight & Sun Tunnel Installation San Francisco | ROOF EXPRESSBrighten Your Home with Natural Light in San Francisco, CA
If you're looking to enhance your home with natural light, skylight and sun tunnel installation in San Francisco is one of the best upgrades you can make. At ROOF EXPRESS, we specialize in installing high-quality skylights and sun tunnels designed to perform in San Francisco’s foggy, coastal climate.

As a Diamond Certified roofing company and experienced roofing contractor, we ensure every installation is leak-proof, energy-efficient, and built to last.
Skylights vs. Sun Tunnels – What’s the Difference?
Choosing between a skylight and a sun tunnel depends on your space, budget, and lighting needs.
Skylights

Ideal for living rooms, kitchens, and large spaces

Provides direct natural light and sky views

Can be fixed or vented for airflow

Adds value and architectural appeal

Sun Tunnels (Solar Tubes)

Perfect for hallways, bathrooms, and small spaces

Uses a reflective tube to channel sunlight

More affordable and easier to install

Great solution where traditional skylights won’t fit

Our team helps you choose the right option based on your home layout and roof structure.
Benefits of Skylights & Sun Tunnels in San Francisco
Despite the fog, San Francisco homes benefit greatly from daylight solutions:

Increase natural light in darker interiors

Reduce electricity costs during the day

Improve mood and indoor comfort

Add modern design appeal

Boost property value

With proper placement and installation, these systems maximize available daylight—even in cloudy conditions.
Our Skylight & Sun Tunnel Installation Process
At ROOF EXPRESS, we follow a precision-based installation process to prevent leaks and ensure long-term performance:
1. Consultation & Placement Planning
We evaluate your roof, attic, and interior layout to determine optimal placement.
2. Roof Opening & Framing
We carefully cut and frame the opening while maintaining structural integrity.
3. Waterproof Flashing Installation
We install high-quality flashing systems to prevent leaks—critical in San Francisco weather.
4. Skylight or Sun Tunnel Installation
We install premium units designed for energy efficiency and durability.
5. Interior Finishing & Cleanup
We complete the interior shaft and ensure a clean, professional finish.
Best Options for San Francisco Homes
Due to coastal moisture and temperature variations, we recommend:

Energy-efficient skylights with Low-E glass

Vented skylights for improved airflow

Leak-proof flashing systems for long-term protection

High-reflective sun tunnels for maximum light output

We install trusted brands designed to handle San Francisco conditions.
Common Issues with Poor Installation
Improper skylight or sun tunnel installation can lead to:

Water leaks and roof damage

Condensation and mold issues

Heat loss or overheating

Reduced lifespan of roofing materials

That’s why choosing an experienced contractor like ROOF EXPRESS is essential.
Why Choose ROOF EXPRESS in San Francisco

Diamond Certified quality workmanship

Deep expertise in roofing and waterproofing

Clean, professional installation

Transparent pricing and clear communication

Strong reputation across San Francisco

We integrate skylights seamlessly into your roofing system—without compromising performance.
